output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set in the constructor, minted to the owner, and can be minted in the mintToken function, allowing the owner to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens to any user, causing a integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, if the total supply is large enough.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _transfer function is called by the transfer function, allowing users to transfer tokens to 0x0, causing a integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, if the balance is large enough.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _transfer function is called by the transferFrom function, allowing users to transfer tokens to 0x0, causing a integer overflow in the balanceOf mapping, if the balance is large enough.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is not checked, allowing users to burn arbitrary amounts of tokens, causing a integer overflow in the totalSupply variable, if it is large enough.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value parameter is not checked, allowing users to burn arbitrary amounts of tokens, causing a integer overflow in the totalSupply variable, if it is large enough.
